question: Should OpenClaw land reset-family carryover as a default-off experimental embedded-agent config after the `includeFamily` history contract is settled?
rationale: The code path is plausible and covered, but the permanent product/API/security boundary is whether archived reset summaries may be automatically injected into model context under a new config flag and whether this stacked PR should land before or after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239.

options.title: Land family lookup first
options.body: Settle or merge https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239, rebase this PR, then review only the carryover config and provider-boundary behavior on the smaller stack.

options.title: Accept combined stack
options.body: Treat this PR as the combined history plus carryover landing path and require maintainers to own the new tool/protocol/config contract together.

options.title: Defer carryover
options.body: Keep explicit `sessions_history(includeFamily)` retrieval but pause or close automatic prompt carryover until a stronger product and privacy story is chosen.

recommendation.title: Land family lookup first
recommendation.body: Settle or merge https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239, rebase this PR, then review only the carryover config and provider-boundary behavior on the smaller stack.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and the touched config/agent/provider-boundary surfaces make this the best available owner for the product/security decision.
